about: Electorates for Northern Ireland House of Commons contests 1921-69, which the imported files recorded none of. Each figure is printed in Sydney Elliott, Northern Ireland Parliamentary Election Results 1921-1972 (1973), and is given identically on David Boothroyd's Northern Ireland House of Commons Election Results site (the full-results source ARK Northern Ireland Elections links to, read from the Internet Archive copies of January-August 2020). Boothroyd's tables follow Elliott's layout and are probably compiled from him, so the two are not fully independent; the check catches transcription slips, not an error in Elliott himself. Read by scripts/build-test2-election-manifest.mjs, which fills the electorate only where the contest has none and names both sources in the result panel's Electorate note. Not filled, and listed under notFilled: contests the site shows unopposed or without votes although both sources print an electorate (the site's result is probably incomplete; owner to review), figures Boothroyd gives that could not yet be read in the scanned Elliott pages, and two contests the site does not hold. Compiled 2026-10-31.
